nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: All settings come from environment variables. Never hard-code IDs or secrets here.

nodes.name: SP: list New items
nodes.notes: Status eq 'New' needs the Prefer header unless the column is indexed. Index the Status column in the list settings to drop it.

nodes.name: One document at a time
nodes.notes: Documents are processed strictly one after another. The resume loop keeps the full translated text in memory; running several in parallel multiplies that.

nodes.name: SP: mark Processing
nodes.notes: Claim the item before any work. Prevents a second run picking up the same document.

nodes.name: SP: get attachments
nodes.notes: List-item attachments are not exposed by the SharePoint node. See README section 'Why Graph and not the SharePoint node'.

nodes.name: Pick source attachment
nodes.notes: Fails loudly on 0 or >1 candidates rather than guessing which file to translate.

nodes.name: Download source file
nodes.notes: downloadUrl is pre-authenticated and short-lived; no credential needed here.

nodes.name: Read prompt file
nodes.notes: Path points at prompt.ocr+transform.0.9.md. Mount the repo folder read-only into the n8n container.

nodes.name: Read budget balance
nodes.notes: onError = continue: a failed reading must never stop the run — the report then says 'not available'. The loop state is read back from 'Budget enabled?' by the next node, because this node replaces the item with the API response. Adjust the JSON path in 'Compute budget lines' to the real response shape.

nodes.name: myGenAssist call
nodes.notes: Request/response shape is a placeholder — adjust to the actual myGenAssist API contract. 15 min timeout: a stage can take minutes. neverError lets the loop handle a non-2xx itself.

nodes.name: Parse status + state
nodes.notes: The heart of the resume loop. Also detects a truncated state block, which is the known failure mode at the step limit.

nodes.name: Brief pause
nodes.notes: Small gap between calls so a rate limit on the API is not hit by the loop itself.

nodes.name: Completed or aborted?
nodes.notes: COMPLETE goes to file collection; anything else is an abort and goes to manual review.

nodes.name: Collect output files
nodes.notes: Handles both the file-return and the text-only case. See README section 'The two delivery paths'.

nodes.name: SP: upload attachment
nodes.notes: Attachment upload is one request per file. See README for the Graph endpoint and its size limit.

nodes.name: SP: mark Done
nodes.notes: 'Done (partial)' when only text came back — a reviewer must see that DOCX and CSV are missing.
